desc: Moon spirit: a crescent-moon shaped pale body with a void face, small gold stars studded on it, tiny feet. Abstract spirit creature, no animal parts. Cute and cool chibi, right-facing 3/4. 16-bit pixel art, 1px navy outline, 2-3 flat shades, no gradients, no noise. Round black void face with two small white dot eyes. Lavender, white, violet, gold palette. No halo, sparkles or shadow.
